gameDescriptionHtml:
Mark had a terrible car accident. His wife Jane, who was sitting in the passenger seat, died in the accident. Overwhelmed with guilt, Mark moves to the old country house they had bought to enjoy the summers and starts organizing his wife’s funeral. But the house soon reveals a disturbing presence: Jane’s.

Mark is followed by a psychologist who has left some recordings in the house. In these, the psychologist claims to have planted puzzles to keep Mark’s mind occupied and help him process the grief, freeing himself from guilt.

Game Features

  • Challenging Puzzles – Solve intricate puzzles that will test your logic and intuition.
  • Mental Health – Whenever Mark experiences paranormal phenomena, his level of anxiety increases. Find rosaries and pray near crucifixes to lower the anxiety level and restore mental health.
  • The Deer Woman – Hide wherever you can to escape the spirit chasing Mark.
  • Soundtrack – An eerie soundtrack that amplifies the horror experience.
  • Setting – Explore the country house full of dark corners and spooky surprises.
  • Jumpscare – Prepare for a terrifying experience.
  • Story – A plot that will keep you glued to the screen and leave you speechless.
  • Recordings – Listen to the psychologist’s recordings at any time to discover clues and deepen the story.
  • Graphics – Detailed environments and characters that make the experience even more immersive.
  • Anxiety – Experience a continuous tension that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
